# Portal marks

The observatory uses a shoreline and sampling-point mark. The heatwave atlas
adds a temperature trace; the kelp portal uses an unbranched kelp blade and
holdfast. The shoreline and traces are schematic symbols, not mapped features
or data. All three share the same open cartographic corners and stroke weights.

These editable SVGs were drawn for this portal. They use a single dark coastal
green with a restrained rust accent for the heatwave mark. The wordmark is live
text, and the subtitle retains the portal's language controls. Decorative marks
have empty alternative text beside the readable name.

`favicon.svg` uses the observatory mark at the site root. Page headers load these
files directly; no external font or image service is needed.
